name: Button
summary: The clickable action control — submit, open, trigger; for a pressed state that sticks, use Toggle, and for pure navigation use a link.

name: ButtonGroup
summary: Fuses related buttons into one visual object with shared borders; purely presentational — for a single-choice set with state, use ToggleGroup.

name: ThemeToggle
summary: A ready-made light/dark mode button — pair with ThemeScript to avoid a wrong-theme flash at first paint; useTheme drives custom toggles.

name: Toggle
summary: A two-state button that stays pressed — bold in a text editor; for an on/off setting that reads as a control, use Switch.

name: ToggleGroup
summary: A set of Toggles sharing one value, single or multiple choice — the view-switcher pattern; for form data use RadioGroup or CheckboxGroup.

name: Toolbar
summary: A strip of related controls that behaves as one tab stop, arrow keys moving between them — the row above an editor or table.

name: Calendar
summary: An inline month grid for picking one day, several days, or a range; for a form field that opens a calendar on demand, use DatePicker.

name: Checkbox
summary: An independent yes/no option with an optional mixed state; for one-of-many use RadioGroup, for a setting that applies immediately use Switch.

name: CheckboxGroup
summary: One array value shared by several Checkboxes, with an optional parent checkbox that summarises and toggles the lot.

name: ColorPicker
summary: Full color selection — saturation/brightness canvas, hue and alpha rails, preset swatches, and a text field that speaks four CSS notations.

name: Combobox
summary: A text input combined with a filterable option list — the Select to reach for once the list is long enough to need typing.

name: DatePicker
summary: A form field that opens a Calendar in a popover — the input-shaped way to pick a day or a range.

name: Field
summary: Wires one control to its label, description and error message, and owns the validation state they all read — the wrapper every form control sits in.

name: Fieldset
summary: Groups related Fields under one legend, without the browser's default fieldset chrome.

name: Form
summary: A <form> that aggregates every Field's validity, blocks submission until they pass, and routes server errors back to fields by name.

name: Input
summary: The single-line text field; wrap in Field for label and error wiring, in InputGroup for inner icons and buttons; for numbers use NumberField.

name: InputGroup
summary: Puts icons, prefixes, buttons and counters inside a text field's boundary instead of bolted onto it.

name: NumberField
summary: A text input that knows it holds a number — parses, formats, steps, clamps, and scrubs by dragging; use over Input whenever the value is numeric.

name: OTPField
summary: A row of single-character slots holding one verification code — one value, one tab stop, and paste that lands where you expect.

name: Radio
summary: One option in a mutually exclusive set — always rendered inside a RadioGroup.

name: RadioGroup
summary: A single choice among a few options that all stay visible; once the list grows past a handful, use Select.

name: Select
summary: A dropdown for choosing one option from a closed list; once the list is long enough to need typing to navigate, use Combobox.

name: Slider
summary: Picks a numeric value or range by feel along a track; when the exact number matters more than the feel, use NumberField.

name: Switch
summary: An on/off control whose change applies immediately — no submit step; for a value collected and submitted by a form, use Checkbox.

name: Textarea
summary: A multi-line text control sized in rows, with an optional ceiling and CSS-driven auto-growth.

name: AlertDialog
summary: A modal for decisions that must be answered — it cannot be dismissed by clicking outside; the shape for destructive confirms. Shares Dialog's parts (see Dialog's props.json keys) under AlertDialog.*.

name: ContextMenu
summary: A Menu that opens at the pointer on right-click or long-press over a region of the page rather than off a button.

name: Dialog
summary: A modal surface that takes focus until dismissed; for confirmations that must be answered use AlertDialog, for edge-anchored panels use Drawer.

name: Drawer
summary: A panel that slides in from any screen edge, with drag-to-dismiss and snap points; for a centered modal use Dialog.

name: Menu
summary: A button-opened list of commands with checkable items, submenus and shortcut hints; for choosing a form value use Select instead.

name: Menubar
summary: A row of Menus that behave as one strip — the application menu bar.

name: Popover
summary: An anchored non-modal surface for content the user reads or acts on — tabbable and touch-reachable; for a hover-only hint use Tooltip.

name: PreviewCard
summary: A rich preview of a link's destination revealed by resting on it — supplementary by design, never the only route to what it shows.

name: Toast
summary: Short transient messages raised imperatively from anywhere via useToast; for a persistent in-page message use Alert.

name: Tooltip
summary: A short label shown on hover or focus naming a control — never the only carrier of essential content; for interactive content use Popover.

name: AppBar
summary: The bar across the top of a screen — leading controls, a title and trailing actions, pinned, elevating or hiding on scroll; for a one-tab-stop strip of controls inside it, use Toolbar.

name: Breadcrumb
summary: The trail of ancestors above the current page, with automatic separators and a collapsible middle for narrow screens.

name: NavigationMenu
summary: A horizontal site-nav bar whose items open one shared panel of links that slides and resizes between them.

name: NavList
summary: A sidebar's vertical page list — titled sections, collapsible groups, nesting, and a controlled notion of the current page.

name: Pagination
summary: Page controls for a long set — previous, next, numbered pages and an ellipsis; for moving through steps of one task use Tabs, and for a position within a document use Breadcrumb.

name: Steps
summary: A numbered sequence of steps and the user's position in it — a wizard header or an order's progress; for a single fraction done, use Progress instead.

name: Tabs
summary: Switches between panels of related content in the same place, with a sliding active indicator.

name: Accordion
summary: A stack of headings that each expand a panel, one or several open at a time; for a single independent disclosure, use Collapsible.

name: Alert
summary: A persistent in-page message about the page's state — the static counterpart to Toast, which is transient and floats above the page.

name: AspectRatio
summary: Reserves a fixed-ratio box from first paint so late-arriving media drops into already-reserved space instead of shifting the layout.

name: Avatar
summary: A picture of a person or thing with a sensible fallback when the image is missing or slow, plus an optional status badge and grouping.

name: Badge
summary: A small label for status, counts and categories.

name: Card
summary: The bordered grouping surface — header, title, action, content, footer and media slots for everything from settings sections to pricing tiers.

name: Carousel
summary: A strip of slides shown one (or a few) at a time, moved by drag, by buttons or on a timer; for panels chosen by name rather than by position use Tabs, and for a list that merely scrolls use ScrollArea.

name: Collapsible
summary: A single trigger and the region it reveals; for a stack of exclusive disclosures, use Accordion.

name: Kbd
summary: A keyboard key cap for shortcut hints — works in prose, tooltips, menu items and buttons.

name: KbdGroup
summary: A sequence of Kbds read as one shortcut (⌘ K).

name: Resizable
summary: Panels the user re-proportions by dragging the divider between them — keyboard operable, constrainable, and persistable.

name: ScrollArea
summary: A scroll container with overlay scrollbars that look the same on every platform, plus scroll-position edge fades.

name: Separator
summary: A rule between things, horizontal or vertical, announced to assistive technology unless marked decorative.

name: Table
summary: Rows and columns of data on a real `<table>` — variants, sizes, striping, selection tint, numeric columns, sortable headers and a sticky header; the data, sorting and selection state stay with the consumer.

name: Progress
summary: A linear progress bar — determinate when passed a number, indeterminate when passed null; the circular form is ProgressCircle.

name: ProgressCircle
summary: The circular Progress — a ring for tight spaces; same determinate/indeterminate contract as the bar.

name: Skeleton
summary: A loading placeholder that occupies exactly the space the real content will, so the page doesn't jump when data lands.

name: Spinner
summary: An indeterminate busy indicator for waits with no measurable progress; when progress is known, use Progress.
